name: rowsafe
description: PostgreSQL safety net for AI agents: Rowsafe MCP tools, a safety workflow skill, and a hook that sets a restore point before migrations and destructive SQL.

interface.longDescription: Before a migration or destructive SQL, Codex checks that your PostgreSQL database can be recovered and sets a named Rowsafe restore point (a Mark). If something breaks, you rewind to it from the Rowsafe dashboard. Codex never restores or restarts anything itself.
defaultPrompt: Is the app database safe to migrate right now?
Set a restore point, then run the pending migrations.
Which restore points does the app database have?
